A UNIQUE ISLAND HOLIDAY
One of the West's most fascinating places, Santa Catalina Island,
lies just twenty minutes off the coast of Southern California via
CATALINA AIR LINES.
This 22 mile-long island...with its massive rolling hills and abound-
ing wild life (including buffalo herds, wild boar, and deer)...is
reminiscent of the old west; only with the sea all around.
The picturesque town of Avalon on beautiful Avalon Bay still retains
the gracious atmosphere of Santa Catalina's early Spanish heritage.
And its sandy shores, crystal clear sea, and cliffs promise endless
hours of fun and adventure. It would take weeks to enjoy every-
thing, but even a day on the island is an unforgettable experience.
Make plans now for a Catalina Holiday of any length...and let
CATALINA AIR LINES add still more fun, time and pleasure to your
trip. Fly on our DeHavilland Twin Otters to the Airport-in-the-Sky
high atop Catalina...or fly our world famous fleet of Grumman flying
boats...which land and take-off on the smooth waters of Avalon
Bay or Two Harbors.
Make it a complete day. Go early, stay late. Discover a whole new
world on Santa Catalina Island. Then fly back into the wonderland
of Southern California.
Things to Do and
See at Catalina
One Day
aightseeing deatures
GLASS BOTTOM BOAT TRIP
Most popular of all Catalina trips! You'll be fascinated by the strange
marine life and great variety of colorful fish you see clearly in the
waters below.
MOUNTAIN TERRACE DRIVE
From Avalon, you motor up mountain-terrace roads that afford mag-
nificent vistas - ever changing views from high above this colorful
city and its sparkling blue bay.
SEAL COLONY BOAT TRIP
Be entertained by the showmen of the sea, the playful seals that
frolic along Catalina's rocky coast. This trip takes you to Catalina's
eastern tip.
SKYLINE DRIVE
This exciting trip combines outstanding views of Avalon with a
glimpse of Catalina's "Airport-in-the-Sky."
If You Stay
Overnight or Longer
INLAND MOTOR TOUR
This trip takes you through miles of Catalina's rugged, mountainous
interior and along the breathtaking skyline drive overlooking the
cove-lined coast.
FLYING FISH BOAT TRIP
As 40-million candlepower searchlights sweep from the boat towards
shore, flying fish soar up out of the water - sometimes land right
in the boat.
GOLF
Challenging 9-hole course with mountain and ocean views.
TENNIS
Fine concrete courts and all equipment available at clubhouse.
PICNICKING
Rustic shelters, tables and outdoor barbecue ovens in mountain and
seaside settings.
BOATING
Your choice of many types and sizes of boats for exploration and
fishing.
DIVING
Underwater vistas, abounding variety of fish, ship wrecks in crystal
clear water.
HUNTING
Big game hunting and bird hunting.
HIKING
Miles of picturesque trails.

activities and hotel or tour reservations, contact:

P.O. Box 217, Avalon, California 90704
THINGS TO DO & SEE AT CATALINA
ONE DAY SIGHTSEEING FEATURES
GLASS BOTTOM BOAT TRIP
(40 min.) $1.90; Chil. 5-12, $1.10
Most popular of all Catalina trips! You'll be fasci-
nated by the strange marine life and great variety of
colorful fish you see clearly in the waters below.
This trip can be compared only with the glass bottom
boat trips of Bermuda and the Great Barrier Reef
of Australia.
MOUNTAIN TERRACE DRIVE
(40 min.) $1.40; Chil. 5-12, 90c
From Avalon, you motor up mountain-terrace roads
that afford magnificent vistas-ever changing views
from high above this colorful city and its sparkling
blue bay. Picture-taking stops are frequent. Your
return is by way of the residential section of Avalon,
with its charming homes and profusion of gorgeous
flowers.
SEAL COLONY BOAT TRIP
(40 min.) $1.30; Chil. 5-12, 80c
Be entertained by the showmen of the sea, the
playful seals that frolic along Catalina's rocky coast.
This trip takes you to Catalina's eastern tip. Enjoy
rugged mountain scenery. clean fresh air, and the
amusing capers of the many seals who make this
shoreline their home.
SKYLINE DRIVE
(1 - 3/4 hrs.) $2.50; Chil. 5-12, $1.50
This exciting trip combines outstanding views of
Avalon with a glimpse of Catalina's mountainous
interior. You'll stop at Catalina's
"Airport-in-the-
Sky." an airport that was made by leveling two
mountain peaks. From mountain top vantage points,
views of Catalina's rugged interior and Pacific Ocean
offer outstanding picture-taking opportunities.
IF YOU STAY OVERNIGHT OR LONGER
INLAND MOTOR TOUR
(3-3/4 hrs.) $4.95; Chil. 5-12, $2.75
Enjoy the personal touch of the tour that got its
start as a special trip for VIP's. This trip takes you
through miles of Catalina's rugged, mountainous
interior and along the breathtaking skyline drive
overlooking the cove-lined coast. You'll enjoy El
Rancho Escondido, a working ranch where pure-
bred Arabian horses are raised and trained and you'll
stop at historic Eagle's Nest Lodge for a friendly cup
of coffee before continuing to Avalon. This trip is a
"must" for an intimate acquaintance with the
Catalina that lies behind and beyond Avalon.
FLYING FISH BOAT TRIP
(1 hr.-Eves. only) $1.90; Chil. 5-12, $1.10
As 40-million candlepower searchlights sweep from
the boat towards shore, flying fish soar up out of
the water-sometimes land right in the boat! A
thrilling sight made even more exciting by spot-
lighting the seals at Seal Rocks, or by lighting up the
mountain sides where the eyes of wild goats are
reflected.
TWO HARBORS (At Isthmus) BOAT TRIP
(2-1/4 hrs.—June 17-Sept. 17) $2.70 R.T.;
Chil. 5-12, $1.30
See more than 14 miles of picturesque coastal scen-
ery each way. Secluded coves, rocky promontories,
fascinating sea and bird life, and an interesting stop-
over at beautiful Two Harbors. Lv. Avalon 9:30 a.m.
and 4 p.m.
RESERVATIONS ARE SUGGESTED FOR ALL TRIPS
